children: Gaxos reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of approximately $2.81 million, up 14.5% sequentially and 464.9% year over year. Advertising and marketing expense declined 16.7% from the prior quarter, while revenue per dollar of that expense improved approximately 38%. The company ended the quarter with approximately $13.30 million in cash and short-term investments.
Consolidated revenue was approximately $2.81 million, compared with approximately $2.46 million in the second quarter of 2026 and $0.50 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Advertising and marketing expense was approximately $2.62 million, down from approximately $3.14 million in the second quarter.
Revenue per dollar of advertising and marketing expense was approximately $1.08, compared with $0.78 in the prior quarter.
Basic and diluted net loss per common share attributable to common shareholders was $0.08, compared with $0.14 in the third quarter of 2025.
Cash and short-term investments totaled approximately $13.30 million as of September 30, 2026, compared with approximately $11.44 million at June 30, 2026.
Gaxos said it is focused on increasing recurring and repeat revenue across its core operating businesses.
The company is prioritizing improved customer-acquisition efficiency and advertising payback, and plans to scale products and channels with favorable contribution economics.

Gaxos received approximately $3.17 million in net proceeds from warrant exercises and issued 3,007,654 common shares during the quarter. It did not issue shares through its at-the-market offering program during the period.

Operations include Gaxos Labs, which develops and commercializes AI-powered applications, and majority-owned RNK Health, which offers personalized weight loss, longevity, and performance treatments. Gaxos also holds a strategic minority investment in America First Defense.AI.
